The affixes इनच् and पिटच् come in the sense of 'a hooked nose' after the word नि ; and चिक् and चि are the substitutes of नि before those affixes respectively.

Terms: इनच् and पिटच्

The affix कप्‌ is added to a बहुव्रीहि समास the last member of which ends in इन् when a feminine word is denoted

Terms: कप्‌

The final इन् of a भ अङ्ग (stem) remains unaltered before the non-Patronymic अण् affix.

Terms: प्रकृति भाव
